title: When you pray, God fights battles you’ll never even know existed.
paragraphs:
When you pray, God fights battles you’ll never even know existed.
Victory doesn’t always look like winning… sometimes it looks like never having to face the fight at all. 🙏🔥
Keep praying. Something is happening in the unseen.
“The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.” — Exodus 14:14
